prompts.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Create a NEW single landscape software project banner in standard 16:9 format, exactly the same output resolution as the other banners in this series (1672 x 941 pixels). Full-bleed opaque background, no border.
Project: Chat Laetus, a conversational AI API and web client supporting text and image questions.
An elegant editorial illustration on deep forest-green paper-textured background. Two large overlapping mint and lavender speech bubbles with three dots, one small ivory-framed landscape picture symbol, and a single flowing mint/lavender conversation thread. These three simple symbolic objects are the ENTIRE scene. No people, faces, animals, flowers, plants, robot mascots, buildings, desks, UI screens, code or badges. Calm thoughtful software identity.
Large beautifully typeset ivory title in a refined serif face, exactly: "Chat Laetus". Keep text and important symbols 7% inside the edges. Use a spacious balanced layout with the large title in the upper third and the speech and image symbols below it. Subtle tactile paper texture, clear shapes, readable at small thumbnail size. No other text, subtitle, dates, watermark or labels.

Use case: ads-marketing.
Asset type: finished banner for a software project's GitHub README and portfolio.
Create one single landscape banner, EXACTLY 1536 x 864 pixels, aspect ratio 16:9, opaque full-bleed background. This is one member of a coherent five-banner collection: elegant editorial illustration, restrained depth and subtle paper texture, generous breathing room, a large highly legible project title integrated into the composition, and one clear project-specific illustration. Keep all important elements within a 7% safe margin. Match the output size across the collection. Do not show a web browser, fake dashboard, application screenshot, code, technology badges, performance claims, dates, watermarks, or extra labels. Title text must be accurate and remain readable at thumbnail size.
Primary request: UNINOTE — a university study notebook project where knowledge becomes a connected mind map, across web and Android.
Visual concept: an open notebook and a clear branching constellation of blank note cards, softly connected by blue lines; a small blue bookmark and warm paper surfaces. Sky blue and ivory palette inspired by the original project's light-blue UI. Intelligent, fresh, organized and friendly, with a refined editorial illustration and subtle depth, no fake interface.
Text (verbatim): "UNINOTE"
Only that title, no subtitle.

Use case: compositing.
Image 1 is the existing banner to revise. Image 2 is the ORIGINAL PROJECT ICON to place in it.
The user wants an icon-placement banner, not a newly illustrated interpretation of their icon.
Create a polished minimal software-project banner with a single clean rectangular icon tile placed beside the large project title. Use Image 2 AS-IS as a flat raster graphic on the tile: keep all its shapes, lettering, colors, white background, proportions and original identity unchanged. Do not redraw, reinterpret, stylize, give it 3D volume, or invent additional objects. Preserve the entire original icon asset including any wordmark already in it, scaled proportionally. The icon should be prominently visible and separated from the project title with generous breathing room.
Remove the decorative illustrative scene from Image 1. Background: warm cream background with a quiet sage-green lower band. Keep the sun and mountains ONLY INSIDE the original icon, not extended into a landscape. A subtle paper texture and at most two restrained flat geometric accent shapes are allowed. Consistent collection layout: icon tile in the left third, large title in the right two-thirds, vertically centered, safe margins, plenty of space. No subtitle, no small labels, no additional logos, no people, no screenshot.
